section_summary.extract_value: This section details the statistical analysis methods employed, including independent sample t-tests, one-way ANOVA, Pearson's (r) for bivariate relationships, and Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) using IBM SPSS and AMOS software. It also describes procedures for constructing latent variables, checking data normality (skewness scores), handling outliers, replacing missing scores (up to 15%), and evaluating model fit using SRMR, CFI, and RMSEA indices.
